summary:
ALL PASS. Re-tested /qr-generate after main agent removed the conflicting bwip-js params. (1) Data Matrix image renders — [data-testid='dm-preview-image'] is present, its inner src is a valid 'data:image/png;base64,...' PNG (16,190 chars). (2) [data-testid='dm-error'] is NOT present. (3) [data-testid='dm-payload'] text = '202607' and matches the browser's current YYYYMM (July 2026). (4) Save as PNG / Share and Print Sheet (18 stickers) buttons are ENABLED (aria-disabled: null, disabled: null). (5) SYMBOL-TYPE DECODE via zxing-cpp 3.0.0 on the decoded PNG returned exactly ONE barcode with format='Data Matrix' and text='202607' — confirming it is a Data Matrix (NOT a QR Code) AND the encoded payload equals the on-screen YYYYMM. (6) Static code review of /app/frontend/app/qr-generate.tsx confirms bwip-js is invoked with EXACTLY the requested option set: {bcid:'datamatrix', text: now.payload, scale:30, padding:1, version:'10x10', backgroundcolor:'FFFFFF', barcolor:'000000'} — no `columns`, no `rows`, no `format` (lines 54-62). (7) buildPrintHtml sanity: `Array.from({ length: 18 })` (line 147), `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 60mm)` (line 115), each width:30mm / height:30mm (lines 132-133), NO garage-name heading, NO 'Month:'/'Code:' subheader, NO 'MPAS' footer. Per-sticker `
${label}
` (line 152) is retained as INTENDED per the review note. (8) Home page loads and shows the 'Backend Management' tile — no regression. Only carry-over dev warnings from RN Web: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated — not new, not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — carry-over from earlier iterations, not blocking. Reference: any component still using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius or the pointerEvents prop on RN primitives.

action_items: LOW (carry-over, non-blocking): Migrate RN 'shadow*' style props to `boxShadow` and move `pointerEvents` from prop to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: bwip-js invocation is now exactly as required — verified line by line against the request (lines 54-62 of qr-generate.tsx). No `columns` / `rows` / `format` present.
buildPrintHtml grid math correct: 3*60mm + 2*6mm gaps + 2*2mm padding + 2*8mm page margin = 200mm ≤ 210mm A4 width — no shrink-to-fit. Exactly 18 sticker divs.
Per-sticker `.lbl` (line 152) is intentionally kept — user requires the guarantee month visible on each sticker for human readability. Confirmed against reviewer note.
testIDs `dm-preview-image`, `dm-error`, `dm-payload` are in place, enabling deterministic future testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — image renders, symbol type = Data Matrix, decoded text = '202607' matches YYYYMM, both action buttons enabled, print HTML meets spec, home navigation intact.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bwip-js param-conflict bug from iteration 3 is fully resolved. zxing-cpp 3.0.0 is available and correctly decodes the rendered PNG as `Data Matrix` with text equal to the current YYYYMM.
